title: Student Life 1: Arrival
zh: 留学生活·第1集 到达
paras: My name is Lin and I come from China.
我叫琳，来自中国。
Today I arrived in London.
今天我到了伦敦。
The flight took twelve hours.
飞行花了十二个小时。
I am tired but excited.
我很累，但很兴奋。
A student from the university met me.
一位大学的学生来接我。
We took the train to the city.
我们坐火车进城。
Everything looks new to me.
一切对我来说都是新的。
Tomorrow I will see my room.
明天我要去看我的房间。

title: Student Life 2: The Room
zh: 留学生活·第2集 找住处
paras: My room is small but bright.
我的房间小但明亮。
There is a bed, a desk and a shelf.
有一张床、一张桌子和一个架子。
I share the kitchen with three people.
我和三个人共用厨房。
My neighbour is from Spain.
我的邻居来自西班牙。
He showed me the supermarket.
他带我去了超市。
The rent is four hundred a month.
房租每月四百。
It is not cheap, but it is close to school.
不便宜，但离学校近。
Tonight I will cook for the first time.
今晚我要第一次做饭。

title: Student Life 3: First Day
zh: 留学生活·第3集 开学第一天
paras: Today was my first day at university.
今天是我在大学的第一天。
I got lost twice on campus.
我在校园里迷路了两次。
The lecture hall was full of students.
阶梯教室里坐满了学生。
The professor spoke very fast.
教授讲得很快。
I understood maybe half of it.
我大概听懂了一半。
A girl next to me lent me her notes.
旁边的女生把笔记借给了我。
We had coffee together afterwards.
之后我们一起喝了咖啡。
I think I will like it here.
我想我会喜欢这里的。

title: Student Life 4: The Job
zh: 留学生活·第4集 打工
paras: I need money, so I look for a job.
我需要钱，所以在找工作。
A café near the station is hiring.
车站附近的咖啡馆在招人。
I sent an email and they called me.
我发了邮件，他们打来电话。
The interview was short and friendly.
面试很短，气氛友好。
I start next Monday, three days a week.
我下周一开始，每周三天。
My English gets better every shift.
每上一次班英语都进步一点。
Customers speak fast, but I ask them to repeat.
客人说得快，但我会请他们重复。
Working here is harder than studying.
在这儿工作比学习还累。

title: Student Life 5: Homesick
zh: 留学生活·第5集 想家
paras: Last week I felt homesick for the first time.
上周我第一次感到想家。
It was raining and I had no plans.
当时在下雨，我也没什么安排。
I called my parents for an hour.
我给父母打了一个小时电话。
My mother asked whether I was eating well.
妈妈问我有没有好好吃饭。
I said yes, but she did not believe me.
我说有，但她不信。
Afterwards I cooked a dish from home.
之后我做了一道家乡菜。
The smell alone made me feel better.
光是那个味道就让我好受多了。
Missing home does not mean I want to go back.
想家并不代表我想回去。

title: Student Life 6: One Year Later
zh: 留学生活·第6集 一年之后
paras: A year has passed since I arrived.
我到这里已经一年了。
I no longer get lost on campus.
我在校园里不会再迷路了。
I can follow a whole lecture now.
现在我能听懂整节课。
My accent is still there, and that is fine.
我的口音还在，这没什么。
I have friends from four different countries.
我有来自四个国家的朋友。
We argue about food and agree about exams.
我们为食物争论，为考试达成一致。
Next year I want to do an internship.
明年我想去实习。
The person who arrived last year would not recognise me.
去年刚到的那个我，恐怕认不出现在的我。
